design: Warm start each H698 sparse routed-readout fit. Freeze hard edges, keep node gates on. Fresh Adam continuous-weight refits using aggregate normalizedMSE or equal-output normalizedMSE. Same minibatches within seed. Independent validation selects corresponding objective every100steps including untouched incumbent. Heldout only before/after selected fit.
limitations: Warmstart optimization diagnosis, not from-scratch reliability; fixed supplied routing and learned edge support. Different loss/selection objectives; no attribution of change solely to edge freezing.
